textRun.content: Group 3 — PowerPoint and Google Docs review mechanismOwners: Akshay and Satya

Find and implement the most practical way for the agent to receive, read, and comment on PowerPoint presentations and Google Docs whitepapers. You have flexibility to choose the tools and integration approach.

Start from the current CMS submission-link flow. Determine which links, file formats, and hosting arrangements are supported, and whether additional sharing, authentication, upload, or conversion steps are needed.
Ensure the agent receives the document’s actual content. For slide-formatting review, establish a way to inspect the visual layout; extracted text alone is insufficient.
Investigate and implement native comments where feasible, tied to the relevant slide or document passage.
Handle document access and comment permissions explicitly. Make required setup steps and access failures understandable.
Demonstrate the mechanism independently using sample documents and sample review comments. You do not need to connect it to Teja’s skills or the reviewer UI by Friday.
Share findings with Sriram and Stefan so they can account for where feedback will appear.

If native commenting is not feasible, report the specific limitation and what was tested. Propose a practical fallback, such as returning comments with slide or section references for later display in the CMS.
Identify the reviewed document revision or captured snapshot so feedback remains understandable after later edits.

A standalone demonstration shows a Google Doc and a PowerPoint being read and comments being placed where supported. For unsupported commenting, provide the tested limitation and sample feedback in a form the UI can display later.
